recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create a browser-native mobile portrait platformer called **Cap & Spore: Pennant Dash**. Preserve the source mechanics: side-view generated platform route, acceleration/momentum left-right movement, friction, gravity, grounded jump only, AABB platform collision, fall reset, camera follow, goal collision to clear the level, 30 gate progression, and touch controls for left/right/jump.

Rebuild the presentation as a cheerful mushroom-kingdom adventure. The focal actor is a red-capped mushroom runner with blue overalls. Platforms are rounded turf and brick paths, occasional secret `?` blocks give feedback when bumped, star coins sparkle as visual rewards, and each level ends at a red royal pennant. The UI should use large arcade title typography, pixel HUD microcopy, readable portrait overlays, and controls sized for thumbs. Use procedural Canvas/CSS art instead of relying on stock backgrounds. Audio and fonts must come only from approved catalog URLs.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source is a single-file canvas side-view platformer. The player moves horizontally with acceleration and friction, jumps only while grounded, collides with generated platforms, resets on falling below the viewport, and clears a level by touching a pennant-style goal. Level count progresses from 1 to 30 and ends with a final completion modal. Mobile controls are left, right, and jump buttons layered over the canvas.

## Protected mechanics
- Horizontal momentum, friction, gravity, jump force, grounded-only jump, and fall reset.
- Generated platform route with gaps and vertical variation.
- AABB collision with top/bottom/side resolution.
- Camera follows the player and clamps at the start of the level.
- Goal collision advances to the next gate or final win state.
- HUD gate progress and modal start/next/restart flows.
- Touch-friendly left/right/jump controls.

## Safe transformation surfaces
- Title, copy, HUD vocabulary, toast text, and button labels.
- Canvas drawing of player, platforms, rewards, background, goal, particles, and feedback.
- CSS treatment of overlays, HUD, controls, and mobile hierarchy.
- Audio URLs from approved catalogs and user-gesture audio lifecycle.

## Target remix spine
Build a bright mushroom-kingdom adventure called **Cap & Spore: Pennant Dash**. Keep the same platforming loop while presenting the hero, route, rewards, secret blocks, background, HUD, and final win fantasy as a cohesive family-friendly mobile portrait game.
